payload.title: A degenerate zero-sequence ORPHAN heading (## ORPHAN-LOW-000) now makes every ORPHAN allocation throw a RangeError, where the base reserved ORPHAN-RESERVED-000
evidence: tools/gates/finding-registry-store.ts:417-428 (readOrphanMarkdownStore keeps the sequence 0 of a 000 heading)
tools/gates/finding-id-grammar.ts:102-118 (isAllocatableSequence refuses 0 and formatFindingId throws RangeError)
tools/gates/finding-registry.ts:689-691 (claimedIdsForDomain reads the ORPHAN headings on every ORPHAN allocation)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach: a malformed input is refused where it is read, with a message that names it, not by an unrelated range check deep in a later step
payload.notes: Close condition: readOrphanMarkdownStore refuses, or reports by name, a heading whose sequence the owner does not allocate, so the error names the heading and not a range check in formatFindingId. A test with a `## ORPHAN-LOW-000` file.
